mapper.update: INSERT INTO major_shareholder (merge_key, name_major_stakeholders, shareholding_ratio) VALUES (#{mergeKey}, #{nameMajorShareholders}, #{shareholdingRatio}) ON CONFLICT (merge_key) DO UPDATE SET name_major_stakeholders = EXCLUDED.name_major_stakeholders, shareholding_ratio = EXCLUDED.shareholding_ratio WHERE ( major_shareholder.name_major_stakeholders, major_shareholder.shareholding_ratio ) IS DISTINCT FROM ( EXCLUDED.name_major_stakeholders, EXCLUDED.shareholding_ratio )

INSERT INTO finance_shareholder ( finance_id, major_shareholder_id, inserted_at, updated_at, deleted, sync_id ) SELECT f.finance_id, ms.major_shareholder_id, now(), now(), false, #{syncId}::uuid FROM finance f JOIN major_shareholder ms ON ms.merge_key = #{mergeKey} WHERE f.merge_key = #{financeMergeKey} ON CONFLICT (finance_id, major_shareholder_id) DO UPDATE SET deleted = false, updated_at = now(), sync_id = EXCLUDED.sync_id WHERE finance_shareholder.deleted IS DISTINCT FROM false OR finance_shareholder.sync_id IS DISTINCT FROM EXCLUDED.sync_id
UPDATE finance_shareholder fs SET deleted = true, updated_at = now() WHERE fs.deleted = false AND fs.finance_id = ( SELECT f.finance_id FROM finance f WHERE f.merge_key = #{financeMergeKey} )

UPDATE finance_shareholder fs SET deleted = true, updated_at = now() WHERE fs.deleted = false AND fs.finance_id = ( SELECT f.finance_id FROM finance f WHERE f.merge_key = #{financeMergeKey} ) AND fs.sync_id IS DISTINCT FROM #{syncId}::uuid
